He slowly backed away from the debris, his chest tightening as a cold sweat broke across his upper lip. Every time he tried to breathe, a sharp, heavy knot twisted in the pit of his stomach, making him feel physically sick. He spent the entire evening avoiding eye contact with everyone in the house, keeping his gaze fixed firmly on the floor. He scrubbed his hands repeatedly in the sink, though there was nothing left to wash away.
